c74object.name: ambitap.distance~
c74object.category: audio, ambisonics, spatial, distance, doppler, nfc, mc
c74object.digest: Distance cues for a higher-order ambisonics bus: Doppler delay, 1/r gain, air-absorption low-pass, and near-field compensation (NFC-HOA)
c74object.description: Distance cues for a higher-order ambisonics bus: Doppler delay, 1/r gain, air-absorption low-pass, and near-field compensation (NFC-HOA). Order is a creation arg.

attribute.name: distance
attribute.description: Source-to-listener distance in meters. Drives all four cues; modulate for Doppler.

attribute.name: reference_distance
attribute.digest: Reference distance in meters (loudspeaker/decoder radius): unity gain, no air absorption, and NFC identity at this distance
attribute.description: Reference distance in meters (loudspeaker/decoder radius): unity gain, no air absorption, and NFC identity at this distance.

attribute.name: attenuation
attribute.description: Distance-gain exponent: gain = (reference_distance / distance)^attenuation. 1 is the physical 1/r law; 0 disables distance gain. Distance is clamped to a 0.1 m minimum.

attribute.name: air_absorption
attribute.digest: Air-absorption amount, 0..1: distance-dependent one-pole low-pass (see source header for the cutoff model)
attribute.description: Air-absorption amount, 0..1: distance-dependent one-pole low-pass (see source header for the cutoff model). 0 disables it.

attribute.name: speed_of_sound
attribute.digest: Speed of sound in m/s (delay time-of-flight and NFC corner scaling)
attribute.description: Speed of sound in m/s (delay time-of-flight and NFC corner scaling).

attribute.name: max_distance
attribute.digest: Maximum distance (sizes the Doppler delay buffer)
attribute.description: Maximum distance (sizes the Doppler delay buffer). Reallocates on change.

attribute.name: doppler
attribute.digest: Enable the propagation delay (Doppler on distance modulation)
attribute.description: Enable the propagation delay (Doppler on distance modulation).

attribute.name: nfc
attribute.digest: Enable near-field compensation (per-order NFC-HOA bass shelving)
attribute.description: Enable near-field compensation (per-order NFC-HOA bass shelving).
